basis: bll6422 lies in an eight-gene operon induced 2.3-fold by 5 uM genistein (operon mean log2FC +1.213, genomic-null empirical P = 0.0072); induction requires NodW. Per-gene BH q > 0.05 at n = 3, so the gene-level evidence is operon-level, not gene-level.
The operon encodes the canonical meta-cleavage set: Rieske 2Fe-2S (bll6426), FAD oxidoreductase (bll6425), VOC-family extradiol dioxygenase (bll6427), alpha/beta hydrolase (bll6428).

Rests entirely on synteny with the genetically defined H. seropedicae fde operon (PMID 27878922, PMID 27059806) plus genistein induction. No flavonoid has been shown to be consumed by USDA110 or by any product of this locus.
evidence_code_or_requirement: would need a growth or metabolite assay

basis: 26.6% identity to human FAH over 188 aligned columns, the 120-residue N-terminal FAH domain is absent, and the substrate-pocket residues Tyr128, Gln240, Tyr244 are replaced by Ser86, Gly178, Glu181.

RefSeq gives this term to two shorter USDA110 FAH paralogs (259 and 268 aa); bll6422 is 344 aa and 21-30% identical to every FAH paralog in its own genome. The direct check is stronger: across all reviewed PF01557 entries, every characterised enzyme of this EC aligns to bll6422 over only 17-36 columns at SW 32-40, against 165 columns at SW 151 for the characterised C-C hydrolase LRA6.
The locus contains no biosynthetic genes; its content is transport, ring cleavage and hydrolysis.
Uninformative as a final recommendation for this gene.
